title: Nobunaga's Ambition II
extract: Nobunaga's Ambition II, released in Japan as Nobunaga's Ambition: Sengoku Gunyuuden, is a 1988 strategy video game developed and published by Koei. It was released for several platforms such as IBM PC compatibles, Nintendo Entertainment System, PlayStation and Sega Saturn. It is the third game in the Nobunaga's Ambition series.
